meta_title: Herts Plumber | Emergency Plumber St Albans
meta_description: Herts Plumber serves St Albans and Hertfordshire with emergency repairs, boiler installations, and maintenance. Fast response, fair prices. Call now.
hero_subhead: Burst pipe at 2am? Our team arrives in under an hour, any day, any time. Same-day repairs on most faults.
services_heading: Complete Plumbing Services Across St Albans and Hertfordshire
services_subhead: From emergency burst pipes to new boiler installations and routine maintenance—we handle every job with speed and skill.

services.title: Emergency Burst Pipes & Leaks
services.desc: Water pouring through your ceiling or visible leaks? We're on your doorstep in under 60 minutes. Most repairs completed same day with no surprise charges.

services.title: Boiler Installation & Replacement
services.desc: Gas Safe registered engineers install reliable condensing boilers with 10-year warranties. We'll handle the paperwork and leave your system running efficiently.

services.title: Boiler Repairs & Servicing
services.desc: Annual servicing keeps breakdowns at bay; urgent repairs fixed fast. We diagnose faults on the first visit and carry common parts on the van.

services.title: Central Heating Maintenance
services.desc: Radiator problems, frozen pipes, or air locks? We bleed, balance, and repair your system to restore even heat throughout your home.

services.title: Bathroom & Kitchen Plumbing
services.desc: New taps, shower installations, toilet repairs, and full bathroom refits. We take care of supply, fitting, and tidy disposal so you can relax.

services.title: Drainage & Blocked Drains
services.desc: Slow drains or complete blockages cleared quickly using CCTV camera surveys and high-pressure jetting where needed. Root cause identified, not guessed.

about_pullquote: I started this because too many neighbours were overcharged for simple fixes.
about_para_1: Herts Plumber was born out of frustration. After 20 years working for larger firms, I watched honest homeowners get quoted sky-high prices for straightforward jobs. I set up on my own to prove that expert plumbing doesn't have to come with hidden costs or cowboy tactics. Today we handle everything from midnight burst pipes to full system replacements across St Albans and Hertfordshire.
about_para_2: Our reputation rests on three things: we arrive when we say we will, we explain the work clearly before we start, and we charge fairly. Repeat customers make up half our work—that's the real measure of trust. Whether you need a boiler service or an emergency fix, you get the same Gas Safe registered engineer who'll treat your home with respect.
reviews_heading: What St Albans Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Brilliant service. Our boiler went out on a Sunday morning in January—nightmare timing. Called Herts Plumber and the engineer was here by 11am. He diagnosed a broken diverter valve, had it fixed by lunchtime and wouldn't overcharge us. Can't ask for more than that. Will definitely use again.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Had a burst pipe in our kitchen during the holidays. Phoned in a panic and they came out same day—very professional, very tidy, and sorted it permanently. No faffing about or long invoice. Highly recommend to anyone in the area.
reviews.author: Claire H.

reviews.text: I've used them twice now for emergencies and once for a boiler service. Every time the engineer has been punctual, knowledgeable, and honest about what needs doing. Really refreshing to find a local plumber you can trust. They deserve the recommendation.
reviews.author: David M.
